review_method: Fresh-context skeptical mathematical review of current proof only; no prior reviews or proof versions read; no production code or numerical experiments examined.

comprehension.claim: A finite pure deterministic DAG is schedule invariant; completed cache values preserve its observable outputs under a sufficient key and downstream-congruent equality. Approximate reuse has local error at most eta + L*d under the stated same-bucket Lipschitz and representative-error premises.
comprehension.graph_induction: Longest predecessor-path length is well founded in a finite DAG. Ordered predecessors and immutable configuration give identical arguments at each induction step. Explicit versions or serialized effects are required for streaming mutation.
comprehension.semantic_congruence: The proof requires literal downstream value equality or equivalence preserved by every downstream function and observer. A downstream sign-bit test distinguishing +0 from -0 defeats mere numerical equality but is excluded by the representation/congruence requirements.
comprehension.complete_keys: Sufficiency is a functional implication at lookup time rather than an assumption that a convenient hash or pointer is unique. Omitted changing configuration, collisions, pointer reuse and version wrap violate premises unless independently justified.
comprehension.concurrent_storage: Completed evaluations, retained values, atomic consistent key/value generations, synchronization and memory integrity jointly exclude stale-key/new-value mixtures and reclaimed storage.
comprehension.side_effects: Skipped source consumption, counters, errno, floating-point flags or failure reporting require an additional transition argument. The theorem does not establish equivalence of such effects merely from equal node values.
comprehension.approximate_bound: Triangle inequality and Lipschitz continuity on the bucket establish the displayed bound. A bucket need not be convex because Lipschitz continuity is assumed directly for its pairs. Out-of-region representatives, unmatched discrete dependencies and unbounded derivative error are not licensed.

remaining_application_obligations: Construct the actual finite graph with complete ordered data dependencies, immutable configurations, explicit mutable-state generations and any required serialized effects; prove each kernel total and deterministic on the admitted domain.

Specify the observable semantics and arithmetic environment. For each reused output, prove literal equality or downstream and observer congruence; bitwise claims must cover signed zeros, NaNs and all observable representations.
Demonstrate key sufficiency for every relevant argument, kernel version and configuration; validate digest collisions, identity reuse and version wrap over the admitted lifetime.
Prove atomic publication/lookup, retention and safe reclamation for each completed key/value generation under actual concurrency and memory semantics.
Account separately for once-only effects, cached failures, timing-induced faults and additional memory-fault paths before claiming full-machine refinement.

For approximate reuse, supply actual uniform L, d and eta certificates covering all changing numerical dependencies and every required output, including derivatives; bound rounding when implementing numerical guards or certificates.
Propagate each approximate reuse defect through downstream operations and repeated use using an applicable cumulative error contract; do not treat reuse error as independent noise.
Establish worst-case memory, registry size, cycles, invalidation and guard costs independently; no particular Mumble executive or firmware readiness is certified.
